label: <DEL> step of very short sequences (L=3) starting with i (or l/d/m/x/h/o/2)
explanation: Fires only on the delimiter step (100% of mass), only when L is 3 (80% of mass) or 4 (20%); it never fires in the original or copy phases. So it fires when the model is about to output the first original token of a very short sequence, and that token decides whether it fires. First token i is by far the strongest: 61% of mass and every top example. For L=3 with first token i the precision is 0.98, though recall is only 0.22. Weaker first tokens are l, d, m, x, h, o and 2. Magnitude is highest for L=3 with first token i; L=4 cases and other first tokens give mostly weak activations. Digits among the original tokens lower the firing rate. The predicate (DEL step, L=3, first token in that set) captures about 78% of mass on dev, but precision is about 0.39 because many L=3 sequences with those first tokens stay silent, and L=4 activations are mostly missed.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=i (+5.40), prev3_tok=l (+2.72), prev3_tok=x (+2.37), prev3_tok=m (+2.33), prev3_tok=h (+2.31), prev3_tok=0 (+2.17). Lower it: in_count=1 (-2.10), prev_tok=t (-1.47), prev2_tok=u (-1.46), prev_tok=m (-1.38).
